summary: Frontend-only public-URL review: 78/78 application checks pass across two complete browser runs, plus initial load verification. Solid light beams, round glowing photons, movement/direction, watt scaling, tempo, persistence, reduced motion, DSEG, inspectors, 29 exact device metrics, polling and responsive topology verified. Previously reported +2500 W / 100% overlap is fixed in Detail and Kompakt. Backend testing intentionally skipped.
action_items: Optional maintainability follow-up: split the 728-line EnergyFlow.jsx into focused node, flow and inspector modules.
critical_code_review_comments: EnergyFlow.jsx exceeds the 700-line module guideline; no functional blocker identified in the reviewed changes.
Core photon has opacity animation; halo has both radius and opacity animation. Each moving photon has exactly two circles and one animateMotion, with no segment paths.

Legacy regression selectors still referenced flow-segments-* and flow-particles. Updated the retained EnergyFlow runner to photon selectors, solid-beam checks and both full-SoC layouts; no application-source changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (78/78 executed application checks; initial load also passed)

seed_data_creation: None. Hardware values are DEMO/MOCKED. Watt/direction edges were explicitly MOCKED browser-only /api/live responses based on a real public response; no configuration, hardware-control or database writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main flow run: 41/41 pass. Device/value/topology run: 37/37 pass, including 29 exact API-response numeric comparisons and two additional real DEMO polling cycles. One preliminary numeric harness attempt failed before assertions because its reload response list did not match the rendered snapshot; synchronizing to the next polling response resolved this test-harness timing issue. No application failure inferred from that attempt. Standalone Playwright is not installed in this container, so browser automation tool executed equivalent inline checks; both retained runners pass py_compile. At 1920x800 and 390x844 Auto has no document overflow and all SVG node bounding boxes fit the viewBox; mobile Detail remains selectable with contained horizontal scrolling. Beam centerlines sampled at 101 points each do not enter node housings. System reduced motion removes animateMotion and beam-pulse class while retaining five static light cores; restore and flow-off reload persistence pass. Photon count/duration at 100/400/1000/2000 W is 1/2/3/4 and 2.34/2.16/1.8/1.2 seconds at 1x. Grid +/-700 W moves in opposite expected directions. Battery +2500/100% numeric right edge 930.37 versus percent left edge 936.94 in Detail and Kompakt. DSEG font actually loaded. Screenshots are in screenshots-flow-36. No auth or physical hardware testing; manual reduced-motion setting was source-reviewed, not separately clicked.
rca of the issue: Previous numeric overlap is resolved by conditional power font sizing: signed six-character readout with three-digit percentage uses 14.5 SVG units, leaving approximately 6.56 units between power/unit and percentage. Confirmed using browser-only MOCKED +2500 W and 100% fixture in both requested views. No unresolved functional issue found.
